lesson: Before work, ask what a device reads: frequencies only (coefficient-blind), discrete special values (passed by the interpolation twin), size of local parameters (passed by every unimodular twist), or the zero set itself (identity that holds for DH). Only the additive-against-multiplicative pairing fails both DH and the sign twists at non-identity steps, and that pairing is Vinogradov-Korobov, capped because log|zeta(1+it)| is unbounded.
